item.title: Getting Started
item.description:
Getting Started#

Download#

Official builds are published on GitHub Releases. Choose the package for your operating system (Windows, macOS, Linux).

Open Releases

Install & Launch#

  1. Download the release for your system.
  2. Install or unpack the app (depending on the package type).
  3. Open noScribe and import an audio/video file.

First transcription#

  • Select language and model.
  • Start transcription.
  • Review and correct the result in the built-in editor.
Model downloads can be large (multiple GB). Plan time and disk space.

Known notes & limits#

  • Transcription can be slow: one hour of audio can take up to ~three hours of processing time.
  • Heavy background noise reduces quality.
  • A manual review pass is recommended.

Further documentation#

  • Full technical details: https://github.com/kaixxx/noScribe
  • Add custom models: Custom Models

item.title: Features & Use Cases
item.description:
Features & Use Cases#

Core features#

  • Local transcription without cloud dependency.
  • Multilingual models (60+ languages).
  • Speaker identification for speaker attribution.
  • Built-in editor for review and corrections.
  • Open-source stack based on Whisper, faster-whisper, and pyannote.

Typical scenarios#

  • Qualitative interviews in research and teaching
  • Journalism workflows
  • Project meetings, workshops, field notes

item.title: FAQ
item.description:
FAQ#

Does noScribe run offline?#

Yes. noScribe is a local desktop app; transcription happens on your machine.

Are audio files uploaded?#

No. There is no cloud requirement; processing is local.

Which operating systems are supported?#

Windows, macOS, and Linux.

item.title: About the Project
item.description:
About noScribe#

noScribe is an open-source project by Kai Dröge. The goal is a privacy-friendly, local transcription app for interviews, research, and journalism.

  • Author: Kai Dröge (GitHub profile)
  • Code repository: https://github.com/kaixxx/noScribe
  • License: GPL-3.0

Name clarification#

Commercial third-party products with a similar name exist and are not affiliated with this open-source project.
